title: Dreaming with Mary Sutherland #1
desc: What do dreams mean? How about when you have the exact same dream as the person you’re “just friends” with in high school? And what happens when you get what you want but don’t know how to handle it? DREAMING WITH MARY SUTHERLAND digs right into those questions and you might be surprised by the answers. Written by J.C. Vaughn and illustrated by Traci Spencer.
